label: caiso import simul cap
definition: (PROBE) Import-isolation diagnostic: aggregate WECC import cap + delivered-cost basis, but with the RA gas-commitment floor and negative renewable offers DISABLED (--no-caiso-gas-commitment-floor --no-negative-renewable-offers) to isolate the import-level effect. Fixes the import quantity (tail -8.3 GW, body median -4.3 GW) but leaves the midday price floor high (only 117 negative hours, LMP min -$5). The keeper that re-enables the floor mechanisms is 2026-06-23-caiso-import-cap-floor.
